name: io.github.tonyyang0504/facebook-mcp
description: Facebook (social): me, publish_text, publish_image, read_comments, reply_comment, read_mentions, del

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_FACEBOOK_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Page access token of the Facebook Page (Facebook Login for Business: a person who can perform the CREATE_CONTENT, MANAGE and MODERATE tasks on the Page grants pages_manage_posts, pages_manage_engagement, pages_read_engagement, pages_read_user_engagement and, for read_mentions, pages_read_user_content + pages_show_list; exchange for a long-lived token, then GET /me/accounts for the Page token). 'you will need to implement Facebook Login to ask for the following permissions and receive a Page access token' (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/pages-api/posts); sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric id of the Facebook Page that posts (the Page the token belongs to); publish_text, publish_image, read_mentions and me call /<page_id>/... Env: PLATFORM_MCP_FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID.
